thread:
janelle.finance: Heads-up — mismatch between AWS Marketplace statement and our reseller payout for ResellerCo. Statement total = $148,320.00, our payout file total = $150,512.00. Can someone from ops/finance take a look?

alex.ops: on it. do we have the marketplace statement id and the payout CSV?

janelle.finance: statement name is `aws_marketplace_statement_2025-10.csv` in billing S3. payout file attached in drive: `ResellerCo_payout_oct2025.csv`. I'll paste the top lines below.

ben.s: tagging @raj.kumar and @ops-oncall. Quick question — is ResellerCo using GCP marketplace too or only AWS? Could be cross-marketplace double-counting.

raj.kumar: they only went live on AWS in Oct. I'll grep the billing exports now.

finance-bot: New file uploaded: s3://redwood-billing/marketplace/aws/2025-10/aws_marketplace_statement_2025-10.csv (sha256: e3b0c442).

maria.g: past experience: sometimes AWS posts a negative adjustment line (rebate/refund) after the statement cutoff that isn't reflected in our internal payout extraction. check for adjustments and the `usageStartDate` vs `invoiceDate`.

alex.ops: pulled the marketplace CSV. here's a condensed excerpt (order_id, product_code, amount_usd):
```
ORDER12345,redwood-inference,4320.00
ORDER12346,redwood-inference,8640.00
ORDER12347,redwood-inference,2150.00
ADJ-9876,ADJUSTMENT,-2192.00
TOTAL, ,148320.00
```

ben.s: our payout CSV shows the same orders but missing the `ADJ-9876` adjustment. payout totals to `150,512.00`. looks like we added back the adjustment by mistake during our reseller normalization job.

janelle.finance: can you point to the normalization job? we need to patch and re-run the calc for ResellerCo before payroll cutoff.

alex.ops: normalization job is `reseller_payout_transform_v3` running in airflow `billing_dag` task `normalize_marketplace_rows`. probable cause: config rule `treat_negative_adjustments_as_internal_credit = true` was flipped in Sept for a different partner and applied globally.

raj.kumar: confirming in the job config repo: commit `a1f9b` changed that flag on 2025-09-30. it was intended to be per-partner but defaulted to global. I can push a one-line fix to the transform to scope by `partner_id`.

maria.g: timeline: fix -> rerun normalization -> generate new payout CSV -> validate with statement. We should also reconcile any downstream tax/withholding impacts.

janelle.finance: approximate delta is $2,192. Do we owe less to ResellerCo now? If so, we need to notify them and hold the original payment until they acknowledge. Legal/partner terms?

ben.s: partner contract says Redwood pays gross per marketplace remittance, but adjustments are reconciled monthly. we need to send the corrected statement + explanation. @janelle.finance can draft the message; ops/engineering should provide the proof (commit id + logs).

alex.ops: I'll open a PR with the scoping fix and add a unit test to prevent global flag. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/commit/fix-reseller-adj-scope (WIP).

finance-bot: Job `billing_dag.normalize_marketplace_rows` succeeded on rerun at 1752916200.

raj.kumar: rerun completed. new payout total for ResellerCo = $148,320.00. diff = -$2,192.00. checksum with AWS statement matches now.

maria.g: can we add an automated compare step that fails the payroll export if marketplace_statement_total != payout_total by > $50? Would prevent this slipping through.

janelle.finance: yes please. add a pre-flight validation in `payroll_export` to fetch S3 statement and compare. If mismatch, mark as `hold` and notify `#finance` and `#partners`.

alex.ops: I'll add the pre-flight hook in airflow, with a slack alert. also logging the action items.

ben.s: I'll prepare the note to ResellerCo: short explanation, attached corrected payout CSV, link to PR and logs, offer a call if they want.

janelle.finance: thanks. action items: 1) @raj.kumar push scoped fix and merge PR (ETA 2h) 2) @alex.ops add pre-flight validation (ETA EOD) 3) @ben.s draft partner notice (ETA 4h) 4) @maria.g update runbook to check for negative adjustments on month-end (ETA 1d).

ops-oncall: adding runbook entry now. saved as `runbooks/marketplace-reconciliation.md`.

janelle.finance: good work team :thumbsup: I'll hold the ResellerCo payment until we get ack and send the explanation. keep me posted.

alex.ops: noted. leaving logs and a trace here: 
`normalize_marketplace_rows` run id: `run-20251031-0422`, transform commit: `a1f9b->fix-reseller-adj-scope`, verification query used: `SELECT SUM(amount) FROM normalized_marketplace WHERE partner_id='resellerco' AND month='2025-10';` returned `148320.00`.

raj.kumar: closing loop — merged fix, triggered full reconciliation, updated unit tests. If anyone needs raw files I put them in s3://redwood-billing/marketplace/recon/resellerco/2025-10/ (statement.csv, payout_before_fix.csv, payout_after_fix.csv, run_log.txt).

ben.s: draft message sent to ResellerCo RFQ channel. awaiting reply.

janelle.finance: closing thread once partner ack received.

finance-bot: Thread auto-tagged `billing-recon` and archived for 30 days.
